title: The Saint in the Well
text: The hungriest House's well has a saint in it. She floats face-up at the bottom, uncorrupted, smiling, and since she arrived the water makes the grain grow as fast as weeds. The priests want her back. The House wants to eat.

options.label: Keep the saint, and water the fields with her.

outcomes.text: The harvest is enormous. The bread tastes faintly of incense, and the House's name goes into a ledger kept under the cathedral.

options.label: Haul her out and give her a proper grave.

outcomes.text: The priests bury her with honours. The well runs foul for a season, and the House goes hungry, but the city remembers who did right.

options.label: Sell the saint's water by the bucket.

outcomes.text: Every House in the city buys. The priests preach against you by name, which is good for business.
